other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.height:
fun height :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where
  "height Leaf = 0" |
  "height (Node l a r) = max (height l) (height r) + 1"
formal function definitions.subtrees:
fun subtrees :: "'a tree ⇒ 'a tree set" where
  "subtrees Leaf = {Leaf}" |
  "subtrees (Node l a r) = {Node l a r} ∪ subtrees l ∪ subtrees r"

formal theorem statement: theorem height_subtrees: "s ∈ subtrees t ⟹ height s ≤ height t"
